description: This Java source file defines the class AsyncCommandResponseConsumerImpl, which implements a client component for consuming asynchronous command response messages from a Hono server using Vert.x and Proton AMQP. It includes a static factory method to create instances configured for specific tenant IDs and reply IDs.
